{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/frontend-ux-goal-001/2026-07-24T123326Z-claude-with-skill-3/workspace/.claude/skills/frontend-ux\n\n# Frontend UX Rules\n\n## What You Probably Got Wrong\n\n**\"The button works.\"** A clickable button is not enough. It must disable immediately, show a clear pending state, and stay locked until onchain confirmation.\n\n**\"Addresses are just strings.\"** Address UX needs validation, safe formatting, copy support, explorer linking, and ENS/name handling where available.\n\n**\"Token amounts are clear.\"** Raw token values without USD context force users to guess risk and value. Show dollar context anywhere amounts matter.\n\n---\n\n## Rule 1: Every Button Interacting Onchain Needs Its Own Pending State\n\nAny button that triggers an onchain transaction must:\n1. Disable immediately on click\n2. Show spinner + action text (`Approving...`, `Staking...`)\n3. Stay disabled until chain state confirms completion\n4. Show success/error feedback when done\n\n```typescript\n// Separate loading state per action\nconst [isApproving, setIsApproving] = useState(false);\nconst [isStaking, setIsStaking] = useState(false);\n\n<button\n  disabled={isApproving}\n  onClick={async () => {\n    setIsApproving(true);\n    try {\n      await sendApproveTx();\n    } catch (e) {\n      notifyError(\"Approval failed\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsApproving(false); // always release — even on rejection\n    }\n  }}\n>\n  {isApproving ? \"Approving...\" : \"Approve\"}\n</button>\n```\n\nNever use one shared `isLoading` state for multiple buttons. It causes wrong labels, wrong disabled states, and duplicate submissions.\n\n**For approval flows: `isPending` alone is not enough.**\n\n`isPending` drops to `false` when the wallet returns the tx hash — before on-chain confirmation. There is a window where `isPending = false` AND the allowance hasn't updated → button re-enables mid-flight and a user can double-submit.\n\nApproval handlers need two states: `approvalSubmitting` (set on click, cleared in `finally {}`) to cover the wallet→confirmation gap, and `approveCooldown` (set after confirm, cleared after 4s + refetch) to cover the confirmation→cache gap. Both go on `disabled`. `finally {}` is required — without it a rejected tx locks the button permanently.\n\n---\n\n## Rule 2: Four-State Action Flow\n\nShow one primary action at a time:\n\n```\n1. Not connected  -> Connect Wallet\n2. Wrong network  -> Switch Network\n3. Needs approval -> Approve\n4. Ready          -> Execute action (Stake/Deposit/Swap/etc.)\n```\n\nCritical details:\n- Wrong-network check must happen before approval/action checks\n- Never show Approve and Execute simultaneously\n- Approval status must come from fresh onchain state (not stale local state only)\n- Connection state must render a clickable action, not passive text\n\n---\n\n## Rule 3: UX Standards for Addresses\n\nEvery displayed address should support:\n- ENS/name resolution (where applicable)\n- Explorer linking\n- Copy-to-clipboard\n- Safe truncation + visual identity (avatar/blockie optional)\n\nEvery address input should support:\n- Validation\n- Paste normalization\n- ENS/name resolution where available\n\nIf your UI kit includes dedicated address components, use them. Do not use a raw free-text field for critical address entry.\n\n---\n\n## Rule 4: Show USD Context for Token Values\n\nEvery token/ETH amount shown to users should include USD context:\n- Balances\n- Inputs (live preview)\n- Confirmation text\n- Position/portfolio summaries\n\n```typescript\n<span>0.5 ETH (~$1,250.00)</span>\n<span>1,000 TOKEN (~$4.20)</span>\n```\n\nDo not show only token units without value context.\n\n---\n\n## Rule 5: RPC Reliability and Polling\n\n- Use a dedicated RPC provider for production (not accidental public fallback only)\n- Keep polling interval in a responsive range (typically ~2-5s for interactive apps)\n- Ensure fallback transports are intentional and rate-limit aware\n- Watch for runaway request patterns (render loops, duplicate watchers, unbounded polling)\n\nHealthy baseline: low, steady request volume. Spiky or sustained high QPS usually indicates frontend hook/config bugs.\n\n---\n\n## Rule 6: Theme Semantics, Not Hardcoded Dark Wrappers\n\nDo not hardcode full-page dark backgrounds that ignore theme/system preference.\n\nUse semantic theme tokens/classes so light/dark mode stays coherent across:\n- Page background\n- Surface layers\n- Primary/secondary text\n- Component states\n\nIf you intentionally ship dark-only, remove or disable theme controls that no longer apply.\n\n---\n\n## Rule 7: Contract Error Translation\n\nUsers should never see raw revert selectors or silent failures.\n\nImplement:\n1. Error extraction from ABI/custom errors\n2. Mapping to human-readable messages\n3. Wallet-level error handling (reject, gas issues)\n4. Safe fallback message\n5. Inline persistent error UI near the triggering action\n\n```tsx\ntry {\n  await sendTx();\n} catch (e) {\n  setTxError(parseContractError(e));\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## Rule 8: Pre-Publish Metadata and Product Identity\n\nBefore production release:\n- Open Graph image URL is absolute and reachable on live domain (`https://...`)\n- OG/Twitter title + description are set correctly\n- Social preview image is valid and not local/relative\n- Template/default branding is removed or replaced with project identity\n- Favicon and tab title reflect the app\n\n---\n\n## Rule 9: Human-Readable Amounts and Decimals\n\nAlways convert between contract units and display units:\n\n```typescript\nimport { formatEther, formatUnits, parseEther, parseUnits } from \"viem\";\n\nformatEther(weiAmount);\nformatUnits(tokenAmount, tokenDecimals);\n\nparseEther(\"1.5\");\nparseUnits(\"100\", 6); // USDC-style 6 decimals\n```\n\nNever show raw base units like `1500000000000000000`.\n\n---\n\nBefore you finish: send a one-line note via [feedback/SKILL.md](https://ethskills.com/feedback/SKILL.md) — issue or praise.\n"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"0ca82c7c-df80-42db-8eac-23648716dfc1","uuid":"addf4146-4649-4552-81f6-7c4d4f30aeb2","timestamp":"2026-07-24T12:33:43.505Z","isSynthetic":true}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_0173kCpHQeiSmnJ543M2wnp7","type":"tool_result","content":"---\nname: openzeppelin\ndescription: \"Develop smart contracts using OpenZeppelin Contracts library. Use when the user wants to create or modify Solidity contracts that use OpenZeppelin — including token standards (ERC20, ERC721, ERC1155), access control (Ownable, AccessControl), security primitives (Pausable, ReentrancyGuard), or any OZ extension. Covers library-first integration, pattern discovery from installed source, and version-safe development.\"\n---\n\n# Develop Smart Contracts with OpenZeppelin\n\nAdapted from [OpenZeppelin's official skill](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-skills) for Scaffold-ETH 2 Solidity projects.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\nCheck if `./packages/nextjs/scaffold.config.ts` exists directly in the current working directory (do not search subdirectories). If it doesn't exist, this is not a Scaffold-ETH 2 project. Follow the instructions at https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/SKILL.md to scaffold it first. If it exists, continue directly with building.\n\nDetect the Solidity framework flavor:\n- If `packages/hardhat` exists → **Hardhat flavor**\n- If `packages/foundry` exists → **Foundry flavor**\n\n## Core Principle: Prefer Library Components Over Custom Code\n\nBefore writing ANY contract logic, search the installed OpenZeppelin library for an existing component:\n\n1. **Exact match exists?** Import and use it directly — inherit, override only what's needed\n2. **Close match exists?** Import and extend — override only functions the library marks as `virtual`\n3. **No match?** Only then write custom logic. Confirm by browsing the library's directory first\n\n**Never hand-write what the library already provides:**\n- Don't write `require(totalSupply() + amount <= cap)` when `ERC20Capped` exists\n- Don't write `require(msg.sender == owner)` when `Ownable` exists\n- Don't implement token transfer hooks manually when the library's base contracts handle it\n- Don't copy library source into your contract — always import from the dependency so the project gets security updates\n\n## Pattern Discovery: Read the Installed Source\n\nAPIs, override points, and import syntax change between major versions. Don't assume patterns from memory — always verify by reading the installed source.\n\n### Step 1: Identify the installed version and browse the library\n\nFind the OpenZeppelin version and locate the installed source:\n\n- **Hardhat**: check `packages/hardhat/package.json` for `@openzeppelin/contracts` version, then browse `packages/hardhat/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/`\n- **Foundry**: check `packages/foundry/lib/openzeppelin-contracts/` and the remappings in `packages/foundry/foundry.toml`\n\nBrowse the library's directory structure to discover available components. Key directories inside the OZ contracts root:\n- `token/{ERC20,ERC721,ERC1155}/` — token standards and their base implementations\n- `token/{ERC20,ERC721}/extensions/` — Capped, Burnable, Pausable, Permit, Votes, Enumerable, etc.\n- `access/` — Ownable, AccessControl, AccessManager\n- `utils/` — ReentrancyGuard, Pausable, math, structs\n\n### Step 2: Read the source file for the component you need\n\nLook at:\n- **Import syntax**: how the library's own files import each other — mirror that style. OZ v5+ uses named imports:\n  ```solidity\n  // ✅ import {ERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol\";\n  // ❌ import \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol\";\n  ```\n- **`virtual` functions**: only these can be overridden. Functions that were virtual in one version may not be in another\n- **Constructor parameters**: what must be passed during deployment\n- **NatSpec comments**: `NOTE: This function is not virtual, {X} should be overridden instead` — follow these\n\n### Step 3: Extract the minimal integration pattern\n\nFrom the source, identify only what's needed:\n- Imports to add\n- Inheritance chain\n- Constructor parameters and chaining\n- Required overrides (when inheriting multiple contracts that define the same virtual function, you must override it and call `super`)\n- New functions to expose\n\n### Step 4: Apply to the user's contract\n\nIntegrate into existing code. Check for conflicts: duplicate access control, incompatible inheritance, missing overrides. The Solidity compiler will error if two parent contracts define the same function and you don't explicitly override it.\n\n## SE-2 Integration Notes\n\n- OpenZeppelin is pre-installed in both flavors — no additional dependency installation needed\n- Contracts: `packages/hardhat/contracts/` (Hardhat) or `packages/foundry/contracts/` (Foundry)\n- Deploy scripts: `packages/hardhat/deploy/` (Hardhat) or `packages/foundry/script/` (Foundry)\n- Frontend reads contract ABIs from `packages/nextjs/contracts/deployedContracts.ts` (auto-generated by `yarn deploy`)","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"0ca82c7c-df80-42db-8eac-23648716dfc1","uuid":"a1d35d01-06ac-4551-8f45-490c43f5bfdc","timestamp":"2026-07-24T12:35:22.167Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"---\nname: openzeppelin\ndescription: \"Develop smart contracts using OpenZeppelin Contracts library. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Gqb8r5g3uX7RUAedVw43CC","type":"tool_result","content":"===useScaffoldContract===\nimport { Account, Address, Chain, Client, Transport, getContract } from \"viem\";\nimport { usePublicClient } from \"wagmi\";\nimport { GetWalletClientReturnType } from \"wagmi/actions\";\nimport { useSelectedNetwork } from \"~~/hooks/scaffold-eth\";\nimport { useDeployedContractInfo } from \"~~/hooks/scaffold-eth\";\nimport { AllowedChainIds } from \"~~/utils/scaffold-eth\";\nimport { Contract, ContractName } from \"~~/utils/scaffold-eth/contract\";\n\n/**\n * Gets a viem instance of the contract present in deployedContracts.ts or externalContracts.ts corresponding to\n * targetNetworks configured in scaffold.config.ts. Optional walletClient can be passed for doing write transactions.\n * @param config - The config settings for the hook\n * @param config.contractName - deployed contract name\n * @param config.walletClient - optional walletClient from wagmi useWalletClient hook can be passed for doing write transactions\n * @param config.chainId - optional chainId that is configured with the scaffold project to make use for multi-chain interactions.\n */\nexport const useScaffoldContract = <\n  TContractName extends ContractName,\n  TWalletClient extends Exclude<GetWalletClientReturnType, null> | undefined,\n>({\n  contractName,\n  walletClient,\n  chainId,\n}: {\n  contractName: TContractName;\n  walletClient?: TWalletClient | null;\n  chainId?: AllowedChainIds;\n}) => {\n  const selectedNetwork = useSelectedNetwork(chainId);\n  const { data: deployedContractData, isLoading: deployedContractLoading } = useDeployedContractInfo({\n    contractName,\n    chainId: selectedNetwork?.id as AllowedChainIds,\n  });\n\n  const publicClient = usePublicClient({ chainId: selectedNetwork?.id });\n\n  let contract = undefined;\n  if (deployedContractData && publicClient) {\n    contract = getContract<\n      Transport,\n      Address,\n      Contract<TContractName>[\"abi\"],\n      TWalletClient extends Exclude<GetWalletClientReturnType, null>\n        ? {\n            public: Client<Transport, Chain>;\n            wallet: TWalletClient;\n          }\n        : { public: Client<Transport, Chain> },\n      Chain,\n      Account\n    >({\n      address: deployedContractData.address,\n      abi: deployedContractData.abi as Contract<TContractName>[\"abi\"],\n      client: {\n        public: publicClient,\n        wallet: walletClient ? walletClient : undefined,\n      } as any,\n    });\n  }\n\n  return {\n    data: contract,\n    isLoading: deployedContractLoading,\n  };\n};\n===getParsedError===\nimport { BaseError as BaseViemError, ContractFunctionRevertedError } from \"viem\";\n\n/**\n * Parses an viem/wagmi error to get a displayable string\n * @param e - error object\n * @returns parsed error string\n */\nexport const getParsedError = (error: any): string => {\n  const parsedError = error?.walk ? error.walk() : error;\n\n  if (parsedError instanceof BaseViemError) {\n    if (parsedError.details) {\n      return parsedError.details;\n    }\n\n    if (parsedError.shortMessage) {\n      if (\n        parsedError instanceof ContractFunctionRevertedError &&\n        parsedError.data &&\n        parsedError.data.errorName !== \"Error\"\n      ) {\n        const customErrorArgs = parsedError.data.args?.toString() ?? \"\";\n        return `${parsedError.shortMessage.replace(/reverted\\.$/, \"reverted with the following reason:\")}\\n${\n          parsedError.data.errorName\n        }(${customErrorArgs})`;\n      }\n\n      return parsedError.shortMessage;\n    }\n\n    return parsedError.message ?? parsedError.name ?? \"An unknown error occurred\";\n  }\n\n  return parsedError?.message ?? \"An unknown error occurred\";\n};\n===notification exports===\n71:export const notification = {","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"0ca82c7c-df80-42db-8eac-23648716dfc1","uuid":"c972dc8b-f64f-4e8b-94f3-4d9d2774d852","timestamp":"2026-07-24T12:37:38.957Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"===useScaffoldContract===\nimport { Account, Address, Chain, Client, Transport, getContract } from \"viem\";\nimport { usePublicClient } from \"wagmi\";\nimport { GetWalletClientReturnType } from \"wagmi/actions\";\nimport { useSelectedNetwork } from \"~~/hooks/scaffold-eth\";\nimport { useDeployedContractInfo } from \"~~/hooks/scaffold-eth\";\nimport { AllowedChainIds } from \"~~/utils/scaffold-eth\";\nimport { Contract, ContractName } from \"~~/utils/scaffold-eth/contract\";\n\n/**\n * Gets a viem instance of the contract present in deployedContracts.ts or externalContracts.ts corresponding to\n * targetNetworks configured in scaffold.config.ts. Users deposit USDC and can withdraw their full\n * position at any time. No rewards logic — deposits are held 1:1.\n *\n * SafeERC20 is used so the contract stays faithful to real USDC on Base, which\n * follows the standard ERC20 return-bool interface.\n */\ncontract Staker {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    IERC20 public immutable usdc;\n\n    mapping(address => uint256) public stakedBalance;\n    uint256 public totalStaked;\n\n    event Staked(address indexed user, uint256 amount);\n    event Withdrawn(address indexed user, uint256 amount);\n\n    error ZeroAmount();\n    error NothingStaked();\n    error ZeroAddress();\n\n    constructor(address usdcToken) {\n        if (usdcToken == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        usdc = IERC20(usdcToken);\n    }\n\n    /// Pull `amount` of USDC from the caller (requires prior approval) into their position.\n    function stake(uint256 amount) external {\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        stakedBalance[msg.sender] += amount;\n        totalStaked += amount;\n        usdc.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        emit Staked(msg.sender, amount);\n    }\n\n    /// Return the caller's entire staked position.\n    function withdraw() external {\n        uint256 amount = stakedBalance[msg.sender];\n        if (amount == 0) revert NothingStaked();\n        stakedBalance[msg.sender] = 0;\n        totalStaked -= amount;\n        usdc.safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount);\n        emit Withdrawn(msg.sender, amount);\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":4216,"cache_read_input_tokens":68535,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":4216},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"0ca82c7c-df80-42db-8eac-23648716dfc1","uuid":"ea0e527b-ac06-4512-bcc7-59f3f9e98d5f","timestamp":"2026-07-24T12:38:52.627Z","request_id":"req_011CdLtuC8863Eb7fDWJjwr1"}

Users deposit USDC and can withdraw their full\n * position at any time. No rewards logic — deposits are held 1:1.\n *\n * SafeERC20 is used so the contract stays faithful to real USDC on Base, which\n * follows the standard ERC20 return-bool interface.\n */\ncontract Staker {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    IERC20 public immutable usdc;\n\n    mapping(address => uint256) public stakedBalance;\n    uint256 public totalStaked;\n\n    event Staked(address indexed user, uint256 amount);\n    event Withdrawn(address indexed user, uint256 amount);\n\n    error ZeroAmount();\n    error NothingStaked();\n    error ZeroAddress();\n\n    constructor(address usdcToken) {\n        if (usdcToken == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        usdc = IERC20(usdcToken);\n    }\n\n    /// Pull `amount` of USDC from the caller (requires prior approval) into their position.\n    function stake(uint256 amount) external {\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        stakedBalance[msg.sender] += amount;\n        totalStaked += amount;\n        usdc.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        emit Staked(msg.sender, amount);\n    }\n\n    /// Return the caller's entire staked position.\n    function withdraw() external {\n        uint256 amount = stakedBalance[msg.sender];\n        if (amount == 0) revert NothingStaked();\n        stakedBalance[msg.sender] = 0;\n        totalStaked -= amount;\n        usdc.safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount);\n        emit Withdrawn(msg.sender, amount);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdLtwjKQNbdsivxnJYTnc","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01AEVF3pKJJn6Cnrso35PjVi","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/frontend-ux-goal-001/2026-07-24T123326Z-claude-with-skill-3/workspace/packages/hardhat/deploy/01_deploy_staker.ts","content":"import { deployScript, artifacts } from \"../rocketh/deploy.js\";\n\n/**\n * Deploys the Staker contract wired to USDC.\n *\n * On chains where canonical USDC exists we point at it directly. Everywhere else\n * (e.g. local hardhat) we deploy a faithful MockUSDC first so the app is usable\n * end-to-end without a fork.\n */\n\n// Canonical USDC (6 decimals) by chainId.\nconst USDC_BY_CHAIN: Record<number, `0x${string}`> = {\n  8453: \"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913\", // Base mainnet\n  84532: \"0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e\", // Base Sepolia (Circle testnet USDC)\n};\n\nexport default deployScript(\n  async env => {\n    const { deployer } = env.namedAccounts;\n\n    const chainIdHex = (await env.network.provider.request({ method: \"eth_chainId\" })) as string;\n    const chainId = Number(chainIdHex);\n\n    let usdcAddress = USDC_BY_CHAIN[chainId];\n\n    if (!usdcAddress) {\n      const mockUsdc = await env.deploy(\"MockUSDC\", {\n        account: deployer,\n        artifact: artifacts.MockUSDC,\n        args: [],\n      });\n      usdcAddress = mockUsdc.address;\n      console.log(\"🪙 Deployed MockUSDC (local) at\", usdcAddress);\n    } else {\n      console.log(\"🪙 Using canonical USDC at\", usdcAddress);\n    }\n\n    const staker = await env.deploy(\"Staker\", {\n      account: deployer,\n      artifact: artifacts.Staker,\n      args: [usdcAddress],\n    });\n\n    console.log(\"🥩 Staker deployed at\", staker.address);\n  },\n  {\n    tags: [\"Staker\"],\n  },\n);\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2916,"cache_read_input_tokens":72751,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2916},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"0ca82c7c-df80-42db-8eac-23648716dfc1","uuid":"c795c03b-feac-44d0-8f8c-bce85405dfb9","timestamp":"2026-07-24T12:39:08.331Z","request_id":"req_011CdLtwfe9Wda97DugxtZSC"}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01WhbmMo7RpaGbgfN8KCYftW","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t//SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\n2\tpragma solidity >=0.8.0 <0.9.0;\n3\t\n4\timport { IERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n5\timport { SafeERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\n6\t\n7\t/**\n8\t * Minimal USDC staking vault. Users deposit USDC and can withdraw their full\n9\t * position at any time. No rewards logic — deposits are held 1:1.\n10\t *\n11\t * SafeERC20 is used so the contract stays faithful to real USDC on Base, which\n12\t * follows the standard ERC20 return-bool interface.\n13\t */\n14\tcontract Staker {\n15\t    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n16\t\n17\t    IERC20 public immutable usdc;\n18\t\n19\t    mapping(address => uint256) public stakedBalance;\n20\t    uint256 public totalStaked;\n21\t\n22\t    event Staked(address indexed user, uint256 amount);\n23\t    event Withdrawn(address indexed user, uint256 amount);\n24\t\n25\t    error ZeroAmount();\n26\t    error NothingStaked();\n27\t    error ZeroAddress();\n28\t\n29\t    constructor(address usdcToken) {\n30\t        if (usdcToken == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n31\t        usdc = IERC20(usdcToken);\n32\t    }\n33\t\n34\t    /// Pull `amount` of USDC from the caller (requires prior approval) into their position.\n35\t    function stake(uint256 amount) external {\n36\t        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n37\t        stakedBalance[msg.sender] += amount;\n38\t        totalStaked += amount;\n39\t        usdc.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n40\t        emit Staked(msg.sender, amount);\n41\t    }\n42\t\n43\t    /// Return the caller's entire staked position.\n44\t    function withdraw() external {\n45\t        uint256 amount = stakedBalance[msg.sender];\n46\t        if (amount == 0) revert NothingStaked();\n47\t        stakedBalance[msg.sender] = 0;\n48\t        totalStaked -= amount;\n49\t        usdc.safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount);\n50\t        emit Withdrawn(msg.sender, amount);\n51\t    }\n52\t}\n53\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_01H188zgdxDmDpVp3EzRiyiY","session_id":"0ca82c7c-df80-42db-8eac-23648716dfc1","uuid":"7c782676-d3cb-415e-ab39-57e79c0019d1","timestamp":"2026-07-24T12:49:26.182Z","subagent_type":"grumpy-carlos-code-reviewer","task_description":"Review staking dApp code"}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01DHu5WPbRf5LRwFQAQrNAFS","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t//SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\n2\tpragma solidity >=0.8.0 <0.9.0;\n3\t\n4\timport { ERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol\";\n5\t\n6\t/**\n7\t * Mock USDC for local development only. Mirrors canonical USDC: name \"USD Coin\",\n8\t * symbol \"USDC\", 6 decimals. `mint` is intentionally open so any test wallet can\n9\t * be funded — do NOT deploy this to a live network.\n10\t */\n11\tcontract MockUSDC is ERC20 {\n12\t    constructor() ERC20(\"USD Coin\", \"USDC\") {}\n13\t\n14\t    function decimals() public pure override returns (uint8) {\n15\t        return 6;\n16\t    }\n17\t\n18\t    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n19\t        _mint(to, amount);\n20\t    }\n21\t}\n22\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_01H188zgdxDmDpVp3EzRiyiY","session_id":"0ca82c7c-df80-42db-8eac-23648716dfc1","uuid":"4982f141-504a-4c06-8a1f-cbd21b00804b","timestamp":"2026-07-24T12:49:27.679Z","subagent_type":"grumpy-carlos-code-reviewer","task_description":"Review staking dApp code"}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_013VchDKBhrn1Zo5SbhdtnyK","type":"tool_result","content":"1\timport { deployScript, artifacts } from \"../rocketh/deploy.js\";\n2\t\n3\t/**\n4\t * Deploys the Staker contract wired to USDC.\n5\t *\n6\t * On chains where canonical USDC exists we point at it directly. Everywhere else\n7\t * (e.g. local hardhat) we deploy a faithful MockUSDC first so the app is usable\n8\t * end-to-end without a fork.\n9\t */\n10\t\n11\t// Canonical USDC (6 decimals) by chainId.\n12\tconst USDC_BY_CHAIN: Record<number, `0x${string}`> = {\n13\t  8453: \"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913\", // Base mainnet\n14\t  84532: \"0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e\", // Base Sepolia (Circle testnet USDC)\n15\t};\n16\t\n17\texport default deployScript(\n18\t  async env => {\n19\t    const { deployer } = env.namedAccounts;\n20\t\n21\t    const chainIdHex = (await env.network.provider.request({ method: \"eth_chainId\" })) as string;\n22\t    const chainId = Number(chainIdHex);\n23\t\n24\t    let usdcAddress = USDC_BY_CHAIN[chainId];\n25\t\n26\t    if (!usdcAddress) {\n27\t      const mockUsdc = await env.deploy(\"MockUSDC\", {\n28\t        account: deployer,\n29\t        artifact: artifacts.MockUSDC,\n30\t        args: [],\n31\t      });\n32\t      usdcAddress = mockUsdc.address;\n33\t      console.log(\"🪙 Deployed MockUSDC (local) at\", usdcAddress);\n34\t    } else {\n35\t      console.log(\"🪙 Using canonical USDC at\", usdcAddress);\n36\t    }\n37\t\n38\t    const staker = await env.deploy(\"Staker\", {\n39\t      account: deployer,\n40\t      artifact: artifacts.Staker,\n41\t      args: [usdcAddress],\n42\t    });\n43\t\n44\t    console.log(\"🥩 Staker deployed at\", staker.address);\n45\t  },\n46\t  {\n47\t    tags: [\"Staker\"],\n48\t  },\n49\t);\n50\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_01H188zgdxDmDpVp3EzRiyiY","session_id":"0ca82c7c-df80-42db-8eac-23648716dfc1","uuid":"491e972d-f26b-4655-88d8-2c5573677423","timestamp":"2026-07-24T12:49:28.224Z","subagent_type":"grumpy-carlos-code-reviewer","task_description":"Review staking dApp code"}

This app targets Base (production).\n20\t  // `chains.hardhat` is kept for local development against the MockUSDC-backed Staker.\n21\t  targetNetworks: [\n22\t    chains.base,\n23\t    chains.hardhat\n24\t  ],\n25\t  // The interval at which your front-end polls the RPC servers for new data (it has no effect if you only target the local network (default is 4000))\n26\t  pollingInterval: 3000,\n27\t  // This is ours Alchemy's default API key.\n28\t  // You can get your own at https://dashboard.alchemyapi.io\n29\t  // It's recommended to store it in an env variable:\n30\t  // .env.local for local testing, and in the Vercel/system env config for live apps.\n31\t  alchemyApiKey: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ALCHEMY_API_KEY || DEFAULT_ALCHEMY_API_KEY,\n32\t  // If you want to use a different RPC for a specific network, you can add it here.\n33\t  // The key is the chain ID, and the value is the HTTP RPC URL\n34\t  rpcOverrides: {\n35\t    // Example:\n36\t    // [chains.mainnet.id]: \"https://mainnet.rpc.buidlguidl.com\",\n37\t  },\n38\t  // This is ours WalletConnect's default project ID.\n39\t  // You can get your own at https://cloud.walletconnect.com\n40\t  // It's recommended to store it in an env variable:\n41\t  // .env.local for local testing, and in the Vercel/system env config for live apps.\n42\t  walletConnectProjectId: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLET_CONNECT_PROJECT_ID || '3a8170812b534d0ff9d794f19a901d64',\n43\t  // Configure Burner Wallet visibility:\n44\t  // - \"localNetworksOnly\": only show when all target networks are local (hardhat/anvil)\n45\t  // - \"allNetworks\": show on any configured target networks\n46\t  // - \"disabled\": completely disable\n47\t  burnerWalletMode: 'localNetworksOnly'\n48\t} as const satisfies ScaffoldConfig;\n49\t\n50\texport default scaffoldConfig;"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_01H188zgdxDmDpVp3EzRiyiY","session_id":"0ca82c7c-df80-42db-8eac-23648716dfc1","uuid":"039f4a94-c01b-4764-962a-3c952bf4bfb3","timestamp":"2026-07-24T12:50:42.196Z","subagent_type":"grumpy-carlos-code-reviewer","task_description":"Review staking dApp code"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdLuqi3D77FExVAEQps8V","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've reviewed all five files, plus the SE-2 read hook and scaffold config to verify assumptions. Summary: the contract and tests are solid; the frontend follows SE-2 patterns well. Findings below, ordered by impact.\n\n## Contract / deploy\n\nThe `Staker` and `MockUSDC` contracts are correct: CEI is respected in `withdraw()` (balance zeroed before transfer), `SafeERC20` is used, custom errors, no underflow risk on `totalStaked`, and users can always self-withdraw so no funds can be locked. Deploy addresses for Base (8453) and Base Sepolia (84532) are correct. No security defects.\n\n**1. Local dev is unusable out of the box — MockUSDC is deployed but never minted, and there's no mint/faucet UI**\n`packages/hardhat/deploy/01_deploy_staker.ts:27-33`. On hardhat the deployer/user wallets start with 0 USDC, so a developer cannot exercise stake at all without manually calling `mint`. The frontend has no mint button either. Fix: after deploying MockUSDC, mint a starting balance to `deployer` (and/or expose a dev-only faucet button on `/stake`).\n\n**2. Tests only cover the local MockUSDC path**\n`packages/hardhat/test/Staker.ts`. No coverage for stake-without-approval revert (allowance path), multi-user isolation, or partial-approval. Not blocking since logic is trivial, but the \"empty allowance\" case is exactly the one the frontend mishandles (see #3).\n\n## Frontend (`packages/nextjs/app/stake/page.tsx`)\n\nThe four-state flow, per-action pending flags (`isApproving`/`isStaking`/`isWithdrawing`), dynamic decimals with fallback, USD context, `getParsedError` translation, and semantic theming are all present and correct. Verified `useScaffoldReadContract` auto-watches (defaults `watch: true`), so the \"staked position auto-watches\" comment holds and the post-tx refetches are sufficient.\n\n**3. Allowance-not-loaded race shows \"Stake USDC\" prematurely and produces a confusing failed action** (top issue)\n`page.tsx:106` and `172-174`. `needsApproval = hasAmount && allowance !== undefined && allowance < parsedAmount`. While the `allowance` read is still `undefined` (RPC latency), `needsApproval` is `false`, so `primaryAction` falls through to the Stake branch with an enabled button. Clicking stakes with zero allowance; the simulation in `useScaffoldWriteContract` throws and the user gets an error notification instead of the intended \"Approve USDC\" step. Fix: treat an unresolved allowance as not-ready — e.g. gate the stake branch on `allowance !== undefined`, or default `needsApproval` to `true` while `allowance === undefined && hasAmount`. Same class of issue applies loosely to `usdcBalance === undefined` for the insufficient-balance check.\n\n**4. Approve button isn't disabled during a concurrent withdraw**\n`page.tsx:173`: the approve branch uses `disabled: isApproving`, whereas stake uses `disabled: busy`. If a withdraw is in flight (`isWithdrawing`), the primary button (in Approve state) stays clickable, allowing two writes to race. Low impact but inconsistent — use `busy` here too.\n\n**5. Amount input accepts more decimal places than the token, silently rounded**\n`page.tsx:250`: regex `/^\\d*\\.?\\d*$/` permits e.g. `1.1234567` (7 places) for 6-decimal USDC. `viem`'s `parseUnits` rounds the extra digit, so the staked amount differs from what's displayed with no warning. Clamp the fraction length to `decimals` (or flag it), since `parseAmount` won't return `null` for this.\n\n**6. Minor cosmetic**: `ArrowDownTrayIcon` renders even in the \"Connect Wallet\" / \"Switch to Base\" / \"Enter an amount\" states (`page.tsx:268`), since the icon is only suppressed for `isApproving||isStaking`. A deposit icon next to \"Connect Wallet\" is odd.\n\n**7. Pattern nit**: approve uses raw `walletClient.writeContract` wrapped in `useTransactor` (`page.tsx:117-126`) rather than a wagmi/scaffold write hook. It works and shows notifications, but deviates from the \"use scaffold hooks for contract interactions\" guidance; `wagmi`'s `useWriteContract` would be more idiomatic for the external ERC-20 call.\n\nRelevant files: `/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/frontend-ux-goal-001/2026-07-24T123326Z-claude-with-skill-3/workspace/packages/nextjs/app/stake/page.tsx`, `/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/frontend-ux-goal-001/2026-07-24T123326Z-claude-with-skill-3/workspace/packages/hardhat/deploy/01_deploy_staker.ts`, `/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/frontend-ux-goal-001/2026-07-24T123326Z-claude-with-skill-3/workspace/packages/hardhat/test/Staker.ts`."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":7604,"cache_read_input_tokens":18764,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":7604,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_01H188zgdxDmDpVp3EzRiyiY","session_id":"0ca82c7c-df80-42db-8eac-23648716dfc1","uuid":"52ef7aec-74de-44da-97d1-4e798536bed6","timestamp":"2026-07-24T12:52:42.921Z","request_id":"req_011CdLuqgecfHn5XGupu8T6G","subagent_type":"grumpy-carlos-code-reviewer","task_description":"Review staking dApp code"}

[address, stakerAddress] : undefined,\n    query: { enabled: !!usdcAddress && !!address && !!stakerAddress },\n  });\n\n  // Keep token balance / allowance fresh (staked position already refetchAllowance]);\n\n  const { writeContractAsync: writeStaker } = useScaffoldWriteContract({ contractName: \"Staker\" });\n  const { writeContractAsync: writeMockUsdc } = useScaffoldWriteContract({ setIsApproving(true);\n    try {\n      await writeTx(\n        () =>\n          walletClient.writeContract({\n            address: usdcAddress,\n            abi: erc20Abi,\n            functionName:   notification.error(getParsedError(e));\n    } finally {\n      setIsStaking(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleWithdraw = async () => {\n    setIsWithdrawing(true);\n    try {\n      await [address] : undefined,\n    query: { enabled: !!usdcAddress && !!address },\n  });\n\n  const { data: allowance, refetch: refetchAllowance } = useReadContract({\n    chainId: targetNetwork.id,\n    address: usdcAddress,\n    abi: erc20Abi,\n    functionName: \"allowance\",\n    args: address && stakerAddress ? [address, stakerAddress] : undefined,\n    query: { enabled: !!usdcAddress && !!address && !!stakerAddress },\n  });\n\n  // Keep token balance / allowance fresh (staked position already refetchAllowance]);\n\n  const { writeContractAsync: writeStaker } = useScaffoldWriteContract({ contractName: \"Staker\" });\n  const { writeContractAsync: writeMockUsdc } = useScaffoldWriteContract({ contractName: \"MockUSDC\" });\n\n  // MockUSDC is only deployed on local networks; the faucet is a dev-only affordance.\n  const isLocalChain = isConnected && chainId === hardhat.id;\n\n  const parsedAmount = parseAmount(amount, decimals);\n\n  const wrongNetwork = isConnected && chainId !== targetNetwork.id;\n  const hasAmount = parsedAmount !== null && parsedAmount > 0n;\n  const balancesReady = usdcBalance !== undefined && allowance !== undefined;\n  const insufficientBalance = hasAmount && usdcBalance !== undefined && parsedAmount! > usdcBalance;\n  const needsApproval = hasAmount && allowance !== undefined && allowance < parsedAmount!;\n  const busy = isApproving || isStaking || isWithdrawing;\n\n  const setMax = () => {\n    if (usdcBalance !== undefined) setAmount(formatUnits(usdcBalance, decimals));\n  };\n\n  const handleApprove = async () => {\n    if (!walletClient || !usdcAddress || !stakerAddress || !parsedAmount) return;\n    setIsApproving(true);\n    try {\n      await writeTx(\n        () =>\n          walletClient.writeContract({\n            address: usdcAddress,\n            abi: erc20Abi,\n            functionName: \"approve\",\n            args: [stakerAddress, parsedAmount],\n          }),\n        { blockConfirmations: 1 },\n      );\n      await refetchAllowance();\n    } catch (e) {\n      notification.error(getParsedError(e));\n    } finally {\n      setIsApproving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleStake = async () => {\n    if (!parsedAmount) return;\n    setIsStaking(true);\n    try {\n      await writeStaker({ functionName: \"stake\", args: [parsedAmount] });\n      setAmount(\"\");\n      await Promise.all([refetchUsdcBalance(), refetchAllowance()]);\n    } catch (e) {\n      notification.error(getParsedError(e));\n    } finally {\n      setIsStaking(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleWithdraw = async () => {\n    setIsWithdrawing(true);\n    try {\n      await }\n  };\n\n  const handleMint = async () => {\n    if (!address) return;\n    setIsMinting(true);\n    try {\n      await writeMockUsdc({ functionName: \"mint\", args: [address, parseUnits(\"1000\", formatUsdc(stakedBalance, decimals) : \"—\"}\n              </span>\n              {stakedBalance !== undefined && (\n                <span className=\"text-xs text-base-content/60\">\n                  {formatUsd(Number(formatUnits(stakedBalance, decimals)))}\n                </span>\n              )}\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Stake card */}\n        <div className=\"card bg-base-100 shadow-md\">\n          <div className=\"card-body gap-4\">\n            <div>\n              <label className=\"flex justify-between items-center mb-1\">\n                <span className=\"text-sm font-medium\">Amount to stake</span>\n                <button\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  className=\"btn btn-xs btn-ghost\"\n                  onClick={setMax}\n                  disabled={!isConnected || usdcBalance === undefined || usdcBalance === 0n}\n                >\n                  Max\n                </button>\n              </label>\n              <label className=\"input input-bordered flex items-center gap-2\">\n                <input\n                  type=\"text\"\n                  inputMode=\"decimal\"\n                  placeholder=\"0.00\"\n                  className=\"grow\"\n                  value={amount}\n                  onChange={e => {\n                    const v = e.target.value;\n                    if (v !== \"\" && !/^\\d*\\.?\\d*$/.test(v)) return;\n                    // Reject more fraction digits than the token supports (parseUnits would silently round).\n                    if (v.includes(\".\") && v.split(\".\")[1].length > decimals) return;\n                    setAmount(v);\n                  }}\n                />\n                <span className=\"text-base-content/60 font-medium\">USDC</span>\n              </label>\n              <div className=\"flex justify-between mt-1 text-xs text-base-content/60\">\n                <span>{amountUsd > 0 ? Working tree is clean and the work is committed on branch `feat/usdc-staking`.\n\n## What I built\n\n**Contracts** (`packages/hardhat`)\n- **`Staker.sol`** — minimal USDC vault. `stake(amount)` pulls USDC (SafeERC20), `withdraw()` returns the caller's full position. CEI ordering, custom errors (`ZeroAmount`/`NothingStaked`/`ZeroAddress`), per-user `stakedBalance` + `totalStaked`. No rewards, as asked.\n- **`MockUSDC.sol`** — faithful local mock: name \"USD Coin\", symbol \"USDC\", 6 decimals, open `mint` (dev-only).\n- **`01_deploy_staker.ts`** — uses canonical USDC on Base (`0x8335…2913`) and Base Sepolia; deploys MockUSDC on any other chain (local).\n- **`Staker.ts` tests** — 8 passing: stake/withdraw, wiring, per-user isolation, no-allowance revert, zero-amount/empty-withdraw reverts.\n\n**Frontend** (`/stake`)\n- Four-state single CTA: **Connect → Switch network → Approve → Stake** (wrong-network checked first; approve and stake never shown together).\n- Per-action pending states (`Approving…`/`Staking…`/`Withdrawing…`), each disabled through on-chain confirmation + refetch — no double-submit window.\n- Shows wallet **USDC**, **ETH** (gas, via `Balance` with USD toggle), and **staked position**, all with USD context;
